{{Top|leg}}
'''Flight Control''' was responsible with maintaining all traffic in and out of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star's]] docking bays and ports. Alongside [[Bay Door Control]], they checked flight plans of departing ships to make sure they were legitimate.
